# Dyrn Zefanya

> Digital growth and systems specialist in Jakarta, Indonesia. 8+ years in IT and
> digital since 2017, including five as the sole digital and IT owner of a B2B
> manufacturer. Builds websites, makes them discoverable on Google and in AI answers,
> runs Meta and Google Ads judged on CRM-qualified leads, and automates the analysis
> that repeats. Available for freelance website, SEO and ads work, and open to
> full-time roles.

Site: https://dyrnzefanya.github.io/personal-site/
Contact: dryndarmawan@gmail.com

## What he does

- **Website development** — WordPress and Elementor, Shopify, or Next.js and React.
  Delivered for factories, schools, a business school, a law firm, SMEs and service businesses.
- **Technical SEO and GEO** — audits, intent mapping, on-page and technical fixes,
  schema, local SEO, visibility in Google's AI features.
- **Paid acquisition** — Meta Ads (Click-to-WhatsApp) and Google Ads, tied to CRM
  data so decisions use qualified leads rather than platform metrics.
- **CRM and lead tracking** — Mekari Qontak CRM joined with ad data in Google Sheets
  (Coefficient, Apps Script dashboards), so every qualified lead traces to an ad.
- **Analytics and reporting** — GA4, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, Search Console.
- **AI automation** — Claude API, Claude Code, MCP and n8n workflows that remove
  recurring manual work, with a person kept on the decision.

## Verified results

- **PT Tjikko Sentral Industrial** — roughly 40% growth in organic traffic and 25% more
  leads after the site rebuild and technical SEO. tjikkofoam.com ranks #1 on Google for
  "pabrik busa", "produsen busa" and "busa molded", and is cited in Google's AI Overview
  for "pabrik busa". Wazuh SIEM across 50+ devices cut downtime by about 30%.
- **busabunga.com** — built in Next.js with Claude Code; reached #1 and page-one Google
  positions for "floral foam", "wet floral foam" and "busa bunga" within about one month
  of its June 2026 launch, on a new domain with no backlinks and no ad budget.
- **Sekolah Trinitas** — #1 Google rankings for five competitive local keywords:
  sekolah kristen lampung, sekolah kristen terbaik lampung, sekolah trilingual terbaik
  lampung, sekolah trilingual lampung, sekolah kristen lampung paling bagus.
- **B2B Meta Ads + CRM (anonymised client)** — 105 CRM-qualified B2B leads traced to
  individual Meta ads out of 2,573 WhatsApp chats, 1 May – 15 Oct 2026, with three deals
  worth Rp167M. Daily AI analysis recommends KEEP / SCALE / FIX / PAUSE per ad.
- **nyliem.com** — 1.4K impressions in Google's Generative AI features, 30 Jul – 12 Oct
  2026, up from near zero.
- **Lingga Florist** — Google Ads search campaign, Aug – Sep 2023: 261K+ impressions,
  795 clicks, 275 conversions (34.6%) on about Rp1.04M spend.
- **Hermes AI Agent System** — self-hosted stack on Claude API, n8n and MCP. A GA4 Daily
  Reporter runs in production across three properties, plus a daily SEO audit.
- **Quotation vs PO validation** — hourly Claude check of customer purchase orders
  against quotations, live at Tjikko since July 2026.
